squareFootage.title: Square Footage
squareFootage.summary: Add up areas and subtract columns, pits and pads.
squareFootage.intro: Enter each area in feet and inches (or decimal feet, like 12.5). Use deductions for anything that won't be coated.

squareFootage.notCounted: {count, plural, one {# area isn't counted yet. Finish or fix it above.} other {# areas aren't counted yet. Finish or fix them above.}}

errors.invalid: Enter numbers only, like 12 ft 6 in or 12.5 ft.

errors.quantity: Enter a whole number, 1 or more.

spreadRate.title: Spread Rate / Mils
spreadRate.summary: Convert between square feet per gallon and mil thickness.
spreadRate.volumeSolidsHelp: From the data sheet. Optional; needed for dry film.
spreadRate.volumeSolidsRequired: Required for a dry film target. It's on the data sheet.
spreadRate.lossHelp: Waste, profile and porosity. Leave blank for theoretical only.
spreadRate.dryFilmNeedsSolids: Enter volume solids to see dry film.

errors.solidsRange: Volume solids must be more than 0 and at most 100%.
errors.lossRange: Loss must be at least 0 and less than 100%.

math.constant: 1 gallon = {gal} in³. 1 ft² at 1 mil = {sqftMil} in³. So 1 gallon covers {gal} ÷ {sqftMil} = {k} ft² at 1 mil.
math.note: Theoretical assumes no waste on a smooth surface. Results are rounded for display only.

materialQuantity.title: Material Quantity
materialQuantity.summary: Gallons and kits needed for an area, with waste.
materialQuantity.perCoat: Per coat, from the data sheet or work order.
materialQuantity.kits: {count, plural, one {# kit} other {# kits}} of {size} gal ({leftover} gal left over)
materialQuantity.enterInputs: Enter area, coverage, coats and waste.

errors.coats: Enter a whole number, 1 or more.
errors.wasteRange: Waste must be at least 0 and less than 100%.

math.note: Waste is added on top of the theoretical amount. Kits always round up.

mixRatio.title: Mix Ratio
mixRatio.summary: Part A and Part B amounts by volume or weight.
mixRatio.enterInputs: Enter the ratio and an amount.

warnings.volume: This ratio is by volume. Measure with marked containers, not a scale.
warnings.weight: This ratio is by weight. Use a scale, not measuring containers.

math.note: Amounts are rounded to 0.1 {unit} so Part A + Part B always equals the total. {per} {unit} = 1 {large}.

dewPoint.title: Dew Point
dewPoint.summary: Check if the substrate is far enough above the dew point to coat.
dewPoint.substrateHelp: Measure the floor surface, not the air.

errors.rhRange: Humidity must be more than 0 and at most 100%.

dewPoint.minimumSubstrate: Surface must be at least {temp} (dew point + {margin}).

ok.title: OK to coat
ok.body: The surface is {spread} above the dew point. The minimum is {margin}.

belowMargin.title: Do not coat
belowMargin.body: The surface is only {spread} above the dew point. It must be at least {margin} above.

condensation.title: Do not coat: moisture forming
condensation.body: The surface is at or below the dew point ({spread} below). Moisture is condensing on it.

dewPoint.outsideRange: The air temperature is outside the range this formula is accurate for. Treat the result as approximate.
dewPoint.marginNote: Margin: {margin} above the dew point (company setting). If the product data sheet requires more, follow the data sheet.

math.formula: Magnus formula, with T in °C and RH in %:
math.source: Coefficients from Alduchov & Eskridge (1996), accurate to about 0.4 °C between {min} °C and {max} °C. The check uses the values rounded to 0.1°, as shown.

dewPoint.productMarginNote: Margin: {margin} above the dew point, from the {product} data sheet.
